decisions: Actual HoverCard portal positioning, collision handling and defaults remain primitive-owned; CSS does not recreate anchor coordinates. Native radius/insets are adopted as semantic popup metrics, while width is fluid with an explicit bounded maximum. HoverCard keeps native 10px corners, 12/16px insets and 272px maximum; the real trigger remains an anchor and essential profile information is available outside the hover card. No invented Title/Description exports or automatic dialog role.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
